results.feature: GET /registration/catalog returns sectioned field catalogue
results.expected: sections identity, assignment, location, technical, commercial, maintenance, tracking

results.feature: Criticality is absent from the registration catalogue
results.expected: no "criticality" field — it is no longer asked during registration

results.feature: Catalogue declares core and identity field sets
results.expected: coreFields includes name/facilityId; identityFields includes serialNumber/macAddress

results.feature: Template editor is not offered the fields the server mints
results.expected: assetTag and trackingId absent — a template cannot ask for a number it does not own

results.feature: Template editor is not offered category — the template sets it
results.expected: category absent from the pickable catalogue and from coreFields

results.feature: Employee ID exists as a first-class assignment field
results.expected: custodianEmployeeId in the assignment section

results.feature: GET /registration/defaults derives site from the caller scope
results.expected: location + facilities[] + registeredBy, derived from the user homeScopeId

results.feature: Blank form offers the whole catalogue, requiring only core fields
results.expected: many fields; required set == core set (name, category, facilityId)

results.feature: Blank form never asks for the numbers the server mints
results.expected: no assetTag or trackingId input on the blank form

results.feature: Minted fields are declared so the review step can name them
results.expected: derived[] carries assetTag and trackingId with origin=generated and a note

results.feature: Empty draft reports each missing core field, per section
results.expected: valid=false; errors for name, category, facilityId; sections carry their own errors

results.feature: Custodian named without an employee ID is rejected
results.expected: error on custodianEmployeeId

results.feature: Employee ID without a name is rejected (half-filled assignment)
results.expected: error on custodianName

results.feature: Unassigned asset is valid — assignment is optional
results.expected: valid=true with no custodian at all

results.feature: Maintenance contract switched on requires a provider
results.expected: error on amcProvider

results.feature: Maintenance section is skippable when there is no contract
results.expected: valid=true — most assets have no contract

results.feature: A client-supplied tag ID is ignored, not trusted
results.expected: valid=true and no trackingId error — the field is not asked for and not accepted

results.feature: Malformed MAC address is rejected with a readable hint
results.expected: error on macAddress naming the expected format

results.feature: One-character serial rejected; blank still allowed
results.expected: error on serialNumber

results.feature: Unknown site is refused at commit
results.expected: 422 on register

results.feature: Retired sources (po/scan/erp/adopt) are refused
results.expected: 422 — only blank, template, clone, import remain

results.feature: Template source without a templateId is refused
Blank registration creates an asset
results.expected: 201 with an AST- id

results.feature: Registration writes custodian + employee ID to the asset
results.expected: custodian "Anita Rao", onboarding.custodianEmployeeId "BCSS-2291"

results.feature: Maintenance contract persists in its own sub-document
results.expected: onboarding.maintenance { hasContract:true, provider:"Dell ProSupport" }

results.feature: No serial number is invented when none was given
results.expected: serialNumber === ''

results.feature: Site resolves to a named location, not just an id
results.expected: location.id and location.name both populated from the scope tree

results.feature: Registration is Active with no approval gate
results.expected: onboarding.state === "Active" — the empty approval step is gone

results.feature: Blank registration stores no asset class
results.expected: onboarding.classId === '' — classify later, do not block now

results.feature: Unassigned registration stores custodian "Unassigned"
results.expected: 201, custodian "Unassigned"

results.feature: Commit is refused when a core field is missing
results.expected: 422 naming category

results.feature: Every registration is issued its own asset tag
results.expected: both 201, both tagged AG-<n>, and the two tags differ

results.feature: A client-supplied asset tag cannot override the minted one
results.expected: 201 with a minted AG- tag, not "QA-TAG-001"

results.feature: Choosing a tag type mints a tag ID carrying that prefix
results.expected: trackingId matches QR-<n>, trackingIntent "bound"

results.feature: No tag type means no tag ID is invented
results.expected: trackingId absent/empty, trackingIntent "not-tracked"

results.feature: Create a template selecting catalogue + custom fields
results.expected: 201 with a TPL- id

results.feature: Template referencing an unknown field is rejected
results.expected: 422 — the field resolves to nothing

results.feature: Template selecting the same field twice is rejected
Custom field may not shadow a catalogue field
results.expected: 422 — two paths under one name

results.feature: Custom dropdown with no options is rejected
Template form asks only the chosen fields, with the author required flags
results.expected: the 9 chosen fields less the category the template answers itself = 8; serialNumber and macAddress required; model optional

results.feature: A template answers the category instead of asking for it
results.expected: no category input; derived carries category=Compute with origin "template"
results.actual: asked=false derived={"key":"category","label":"Category","section":"identity","origin":"template","value":"Compute","note":"Set by the QA Computer Template template."}

results.feature: Custom template field appears in the resolved form
results.expected: warrantyAgent present, mapped into onboarding.attributes

results.feature: Template-mandated fields are enforced at validation
results.expected: errors for serialNumber, manufacturer, macAddress

results.feature: Registering from a template creates the asset
Template asset stores templateId and custom attributes
results.expected: onboarding.templateId=TPL-16; attributes.macAddress + attributes.warrantyAgent persisted

results.feature: The template's category wins over anything the caller sends
results.expected: category "Compute" from the template, not the "Furniture" that was posted

results.feature: Template usage counter increments on use
results.expected: usageCount === 1

results.feature: Template list returns active templates
results.expected: 200 with our template present

results.feature: Template update preserves unsent fields
results.expected: description changed; fields[] and name intact
results.actual: 200 desc=Updated by QA fields=9 name=QA Computer Template

results.feature: Deleting a template archives it rather than destroying it
results.expected: status archived, still readable (assets reference it)

results.feature: Archived template cannot be used for new assets
results.expected: 409 conflict

results.feature: Unknown template returns 404
Clone prefill copies shared values
results.expected: manufacturer/model/category copied from the source asset

results.feature: Clone clears every identity field the user must type, and names them
results.expected: serialNumber, macAddress, imei blanked and listed; the minted assetTag and trackingId are not asked for at all

results.feature: Clone starts unassigned rather than inheriting the custodian
results.expected: custodianName === '' — a new unit is not automatically that person's

results.feature: Registering a clone creates a distinct asset
results.expected: 201 with a new id and the typed serial

results.feature: A clone is issued its own asset tag, not the original one
results.expected: clone assetTag is an AG- number and differs from the source asset tag

results.feature: Clone records its provenance
results.expected: onboarding.clonedFromId === AST-150

results.feature: Clone reusing the source serial is rejected
results.expected: 409 — two assets cannot claim one serial

results.feature: Cloning an unknown asset returns 404
Unauthenticated registration is rejected
Field catalogue is not public
Values for unknown keys are ignored, not written through
results.expected: id minted normally; healthScore untouched at 100
